subject: Harvest Your Energy Festival Planning
overview: The committee coordinated final logistics for the Harvest Your Energy Festival and reviewed city staffing updates. Key decisions focused on electronics recycling fees and resident outreach for energy efficiency programs.

items.title: Call to Order and Introductions
items.summary: The chair convened the remote meeting and introduced committee members, department staff, and representatives from the Tufts Energy Group.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the September meeting.

items.title: Administrative Updates
items.summary: Alicia Hunt announced the hiring of a new Building Commissioner and provided updates on recent community outreach at the Mystic River Celebration.

items.title: Energy Conference and Webinar Planning
items.summary: The committee discussed the upcoming Tufts Energy Group conference and a webinar featuring Block Power to educate residents on heat pump and solar financing.

items.title: Harvest Your Energy Festival Logistics
items.summary: Organizers reviewed the festival's exhibitor list and music lineup, and the committee decided to implement a $15 exact-change fee for television and monitor recycling.
